correctness.rationale: The orbit-reduced substochastic matrix follows from independent simultaneous moves and absorption at coincidence. The difference identities are exact polynomial identities with positive M-matrix determinant. Three quadratics have opposite endpoint signs; the Q,R resultant is negative on the a,b>=2 quadrant by a 36-term all-positive shift, proving pairwise distinct roots. The identity S=(b-1)Q+R and an a=b=2 witness prove alpha<beta<gamma. Exact rational full-state checks independently corroborate small cases.

value.rationale: This is a uniform all-size strict phase classification for three natural initial-pair orbits of a homogeneous lazy two-walker process on a nonregular nonbipartite graph family. Its three distinct thresholds are meaningful structural information beyond a generic finite-state inversion and useful for interpreting how initial meeting geometry changes with laziness.
